name: tpm_credential_access

storage.rationale: This safeguard does not persist a host file or directory; the explicit empty declaration records that its effect is runtime-only or externally owned.

description: Grant the operator account access to the TPM so the encrypted credential store opens unattended after a reboot

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: macOS does not expose the Linux TPM device and tpm2-tools interface used by safeguard tpm_credential_access; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.

windows.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux TPM device and tpm2-tools interface used by safeguard tpm_credential_access; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.
